name: Summit AZ - Position 2 and Page 2 Keyword Audit 2026-09-18
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-09-18

# Summary
Audit (no changes) of keywords at exact position 2 and at positions 11 to 20, built from Kim's Semrush screenshots (Sep 16, US desktop, only page 1 of 3 readable), GSC web UI, GA4, project baselines, the live site and a SERP spot check. Two versions: v1 `Summit-AZ-Pos2-and-Page2-Keyword-Audit-2026-09-18.md` and v2 (this note), which adds position-change data, 3-month and redesign-window comparisons, device, country, GA4, pre-redesign records, an Arizona/Utah check and technical checks, and corrects three v1 statements.

# Key findings
- Exact position 2: only 2 keywords, both branded ("summit plumbing pros llc" and "...reviews"), both on the homepage (off limits).
- Positions 11 to 20: only 3 real non-branded targets: "sewer line repair mesa" (#17), "pipe lining phoenix" (#18), "water softener system install san tan valley" (#12).
- /sewer-line-repair-mesa/ is the best page-one opportunity: position 17 to 18 on 6 variants, 212 impressions in 28 days, 0 clicks; 10 of its 14 internal links are one-word "Mesa" buttons.
- /pipe-lining-phoenix/: its biggest query is "sewer pipe relining in phoenix"; no descriptive link from any Phoenix page.
- /water-softener-installation-san-tan-valley/: an H2 named the wrong city (Fountain Hills) and its water-source facts conflicted with the STV general page.
- Semrush overstates (290 estimated visits a month vs 37 real GSC clicks).
- No confirmed ranking loss from the Sep 4 redesign on qualifying pages; homepage brand CTR decline predates it.
- "plumber mesa" ranks the homepage, not the Mesa page (decision already with Scott). Emergency keywords like "emergency plumber tempe" (983 impressions on the Tempe hub) are a business-service mismatch.
- Utah: none on qualifying pages; /about/ schema still had Utah coordinates (later fixed Sep 18).

# v1 corrections
- The homepage does output Plumber/Organization schema; the brand CTR drop predates the redesign; the STV softener page did rank 10 to 15 from March to June.

# Decisions and status
- First priority: two contextual links to /sewer-line-repair-mesa/ (L1, L2). Several held items (L1, L2, C1, C3 to C5) were still listed in the Oct 1 content backlog.
